assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:69-77: Fails if saved DIII-D evidence converges, has no invalid image, has a finite terminal trajectory, attempts Newton, loses final mask stability, or has a different terminal inner reason.
assertion_analysis.check_capture.py:79-87: Fails if MAST loses convergence/finite warmup/accepted promotions, frame 179 gains an attempt/ladder, or frame 137 last ladder accepts, trusts its model, or contains a decreasing merit.
assertion_analysis.measure.py:267,411-412; render.py:51,61-: Fail for disabled x64, absent executed inner seam, empty support, oversized SVG or wrong orientation/shape; the save wrapper raises for clipping/collision/data overlap.
assertion_analysis.negative_controls: Restoring wrong-seam instrumentation yields zero inner counts and require_calls fails, as the existing negative-control receipt proves. Restoring an incorrect per-region assignment need not fail, as noted in finding. No test-input echo tautology was found; consistency and frozen-input limitations are the durability gap.
